feat(replit): add okhp3-replit-repl-janitor v1.0.1

Fifth skill in the replit/ family. Safe, evidence-led cleanup of one
Replit workspace Git checkout — four-bucket branch classification, bundled
audit-repo.py script, kebab-case naming conventions, and detritus triage
policy. Destructive operations execute only after owner approval of exact
line items.

- Benchmark: with_skill mean 0.9167, delta +0.75 (3 live subagent runs)
- Phase 8 trigger eval: 20/20, recall 1.0, precision 1.0
- All 8 package files byte-equal with runtime source (SHA-256 960898a5)
- Python 3 + Git required for audit-repo.py
- MIT license

commits.message:
feat(replit): add replit/ family with 4 new skills

Adds the replit/ family directory with four new Agent Skills extracted
from the Glee-fully Chai Chasers Designathon project:

- okhp3-replit-canvas-board v1.0.0
  Structured canvas presentation board layout — hero rows, labeled zones,
  iframe lifecycle (building→live), focusCanvasShapes presentation close.

- okhp3-replit-build-in-public v1.0.0
  Full designathon submission playbook — canvas organisation for judges,
  artifact selection, dual deployment (Replit Publish + GitHub Pages),
  session handoff, and building-in-public commit discipline.

- okhp3-replit-design-pipeline v1.0.0
  Complete Replit design iteration loop: extract → sandbox → variant →
  graduate. Covers DESIGN subagent brief anatomy, variant labelling on
  canvas, and the GENERAL vs. DESIGN subagent graduation decision.

- okhp3-replit-multi-artifact v1.0.0
  Five rules that prevent silent failures in a Replit pnpm multi-artifact
  monorepo: BASE_URL prefix discipline, PORT env var reading, managed
  workflow naming, pnpm catalog drift, and workspace:* shared libraries.

Also adds replit/FAMILY.md with inventory table and summary block.

All four skills passed public-safety review (no credentials, private URLs,
internal IDs, or employer data). MIT license declared on all four.

Known evaluation gap: okhp3-replit-build-in-public benchmark eval_id 4
(without_skill, dual-deployment scenario) shows 0.5 pass rate — noted in
promotion manifest; under active investigation downstream.
